findings.summary: The proposal changes only the directly declared development pin pytest 9.0.2 to 9.0.3.
The changed requirements file is installed in the tox test environment that invokes pytest.
findings.decision_relevance: establishes that pytest is not merely declared but belongs to the checked responsibility

findings.summary: Exact-head ordinary tests passed on Python 3.10 and 3.14 across Ubuntu and Windows after installing the proposed development requirements.
findings.decision_relevance: confirms the authority missing from the transparent baseline

findings.summary: A separate exact-head regression workflow reinstalled the proposed requirements and passed its direct pytest regression command.
Official pytest 9.0.3 release material describes the version as a bug-fix release and drop-in replacement.
findings.decision_relevance: provides upstream compatibility context without a caution signal

findings.summary: The transparent baseline action is sufficient after a small authority confirmation; deeper investigation would add no material decision value in this case.
findings.decision_relevance: supports merge after normal review and early stop
limits: The conclusion applies to this frozen proposal and public evidence.
It does not establish that every patch update with green CI is baseline-sufficient.
